scope: Four named follow-up reviews for the 22 declared comparison tasks and selected existing public workflows; not closure of all 15 required owner contracts.

guarantees.observed_contract: Scalar empty input returns zero counts and NULL sum/average/extrema; grouped empty input retains its typed schema. Ordered spill also checks all-null input.
guarantees.limit: This supplements the comparison normalizer, which maps absent/NaN sums to zero. It is not independent schema comparison for all 704 cells.

guarantees.observed_contract: Ordered floating addition preserves its declared evaluation order, including cancellation-sensitive inputs and signed zero. Integer-key expression overflow remains observable even in a discarded group.
guarantees.limit: Different floating evaluation orders can return different values. Neither four-decimal normalization nor these cases establish bitwise agreement with pandas for every aggregate.

guarantees.observed_contract: Independent count oracles cover integer extrema, UTF-8 byte identity, different dictionary domains, ties, offsets, repeated execution and pressure transitions.
guarantees.limit: The frozen selected key fixtures do not add nested-key breadth or certify every physical encoding.

guarantees.observed_contract: Retained slices keep their native owner after consumer failure/cancellation. Owned aggregate output remains readable after source deletion and reopens from Vortex with complete values.
guarantees.limit: Credits are released at final native-owner drop; caller/Python/library retention is not a whole-process RSS guarantee.

guarantees.observed_contract: The exact decoder grant passes and a one-byte-short grant rejects without leaked credit. A concurrent retained owner causes denial; releasing it permits an exact-value retry. Mismatched CPU/memory requests reject before file open.
guarantees.limit: These are named provider and request owners; unreviewed provider allocations are not silently included.

guarantees.observed_contract: Bounded queue overflow rejects, cancellation removes a waiter, the next admitted call completes, queued projection cancels before I/O and the session can be reused. Blocking completion keeps its I/O/buffer owners until drain returns.
guarantees.limit: This is existing local session admission, not a general multiuser serving or remote service claim.

guarantees.observed_contract: The current relational writer family checks complete ordered outer-join/set values, empty output, original preparation provenance, and failure before publication after source mutation or midstream cancellation.
guarantees.limit: Vortex reopen verifies DType; text formats have explicit serialization contracts. Compatibility output is not an assertion that every format preserves every native logical type.

guarantees.observed_contract: Real batch-input fanout runs once, observes end of input and reopens all eight destinations. Producer/schema/cancellation/adapter failure before publication leaves no published prefix. A later publication collision preserves earlier complete outputs and the foreign destination.
guarantees.limit: The last two tests isolate publication ownership with synthetic payloads. Multi-destination commit is not group-atomic and does not provide automatic rollback of earlier completed publications.

guarantees.observed_contract: Selected Arrow IPC, Parquet, Avro, native Vortex and text writer fixtures check complete values, NULL/empty schemas, reader lifetimes, source changes, cancellation and staging ownership. Native typed binary fixtures exercise all eight writers; each destination retains its declared type/serialization contract.
guarantees.limit: Text export does not preserve every native logical type. This is existing writer evidence, not a new writer/codec or multi-file transaction guarantee.

guarantees.observed_contract: Actual spill precedes injected input/schema/quota/allocation/cancellation and corrupt/truncated/replaced-generation failures. Named native owners release credit; foreign files and replacement generations survive refused cleanup. Parent recovery tests prove live-owner refusal, dead-owner cleanup and complete fresh-source results for set, unary, sampling, subquery, aggregate, join, window and replay families.
guarantees.limit: Recovery restarts from source; it does not resume partial query state. Aggregate recovery uses an instructed process exit; the other selected parent cases kill their child. Unknown-owner protection is directly checked in the non-aggregate parent cases. Process-child tests alone and diagnostic-capture tests are not independent recovery proofs. Streaming failures can follow provisional output; no completed report or partial writer publication is accepted.

guarantees.observed_contract: Selected installed native Python tests check exact rich types/NULL masks, copied source buffers, typed empty output, complete global order, spill cleanup, producer admission and closure, retained results after cancellation and deferred completion after the final demand.
guarantees.limit: These 20 methods pass in each of three development-wheel lanes. They do not certify the entire 22-task matrix on those hosts, Windows native extensions, process RSS, or every published package artifact.

limits.native_credit_scope: Named native reservations only; original caller, Python, codec/library and operating-system allocations remain separate.
limits.recovery: Owned cleanup followed by a fresh source execution; no partial-state resume.
limits.publication: Declared single-file publication and ownership; multi-destination publication can preserve an earlier complete prefix on a later collision.
limits.platform: The 22-task comparison ran on macOS arm64. Selected development native-wheel regressions ran on Linux x86_64 Python 3.10/3.13 and macOS arm64 Python 3.13.
limits.published_package: Published 0.7.0 channel proofs remain in docs/release/v0.7.0-publication-verification.md. Development-wheel evidence is not relabeled as published-artifact execution.
limits.test_count: 183 unique Rust selectors include two child-process support entrypoints and one diagnostic-capture test; 180 are ordinary regression selectors. Passing selectors are not 183 independent guarantees.
limits.source_identity: Recorded whole test/helper files equal the named commits. This is a bounded source inventory, not transitive runtime-source or allocation coverage.
limits.performance: No new timing, benchmark pass, paired uncertainty or competitive performance conclusion.

next_queue_stage: Existing shared independent-region, exact local-reduction, region/preparation-cost and instruction/dispatch prerequisites; retain their original admission gates.
